title: Return the page count with the product list
body: The storefront pager needs to know how many pages there are. Adds `pageCount` and `totalPages`/`hasNextPage` to `GET /api/products`.
note: Math.floor drops the last partial page: 45 products at 20 per page gives 2 pages, so the last 5 are unreachable (and 5 products give 0 pages).
